searches.reason: Test whether the single-negative SASRec objective leaves difficult candidate distinctions undertrained, especially in Electronics, where 14.95% of sampled negatives outrank positives. Seek efficient multi-negative objectives with false-negative handling; compare using pinned macro validation HR@10 because diagnostic margins alone do not establish ranking gains.
searches.query: sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 SASRec multi-negative sampled softmax hard negative mining false negatives efficient training

searches.reason: Explore an architecture that separates recent intent, persistent preferences, and complementary purchases. The qualitative diagnosis suggests these signals are conflated; time-aware multi-interest modeling could improve immediate relevance using only training histories and timestamps, without assuming observed purchase purposes.
searches.query: sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 time-aware multi-interest short-term intent long-term preference complementary substitute next item prediction

searches.reason: Investigate a complementary recommendation mechanism based on item transitions and locally learned text features. Sparse transition graphs plus title/description TF-IDF could capture specific associations missing from SASRec without external pretrained weights. Seek efficient fusion methods and assess each category alongside the macro validation score.
searches.query: sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 sparse item transition graph collaborative filtering TF-IDF item titles descriptions hybrid next item recommendation without pretrained models
